date.description: Month-end date index (parquet index column); spans 1990-01-31 through 2026-07-31.

cass_freight_idx.description: FRED FRGSHPUSM649NCIS: Cass Freight Index — Shipments. Monthly index (Jan 1990 = 1.00), NOT seasonally adjusted. Volume of freight shipments across the Cass client base; a read on the U.S. goods economy.

unrate.description: FRED UNRATE: civilian unemployment rate, monthly, SA. Control series.

dgs10.description: FRED DGS10: 10-year constant-maturity Treasury yield, month-end value. Control.

fed_funds.description: FRED DFF: effective federal funds rate, month-end value. Control.

vix.description: CBOE VIX index, month-end close (Yahoo ^VIX). Control / regime variable.

spy.description: SPY adjusted close, month-end (Yahoo, auto-adjusted). Target asset.

cass_freight_pct_yoy.description: 12-month percent change in cass_freight_idx. Seasonality-robust cycle signal (preferred over MoM given the NSA source). Effective start = 2017-01.

cass_freight_pct_mom.description: 1-month percent change in cass_freight_idx. NSA source => seasonally biased; prefer YoY-family for cycle inference.

cass_freight_3m_pct.description: 3-month percent change (momentum) in cass_freight_idx. NSA => seasonally biased.

cass_freight_6m_pct.description: 6-month percent change (momentum) in cass_freight_idx. NSA => partially seasonal.

cass_freight_ma12_idx.description: 12-month rolling mean of cass_freight_idx (min 10 obs). A 12M MA also nets out the NSA seasonal pattern.

cass_freight_dev_trend_pct.description: Percent deviation of cass_freight_idx from its 12-month moving average.

cass_freight_zscore_60m.description: Rolling 60-month z-score of the LEVEL (min 36 obs). Effective start ~2018-12; short history limits the rolling window. NSA level => seasonal noise present.

cass_freight_yoy_zscore_60m.description: Rolling 60-month z-score of cass_freight_pct_yoy (min 36 obs). Effective start ~2019-12; short history limits the rolling window.

cass_freight_accel_pct.description: First difference of cass_freight_pct_mom (percentage points). NSA => noisy.

cass_freight_contraction.description: 1.0 when cass_freight_pct_yoy < 0, else 0.0. Marks freight-recession months (e.g. COVID 2020, 2022-2024 goods slowdown).
